intendedUse: Normalize a current Monaco 980NN postal designator, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current Monaco ordinary or special-routing assignment and its truthful postal geometry, with postal assignment, address/building identity, Principality or quartier context and AGID containment kept as separate authorities

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared Monaco ordinary-postcode and 980xx exception allocation denominator, plus real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces, are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real MC API/app so a normalized 980NN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. A La Poste assignment row, the Principality or commune boundary, a centroid, DPUM internal-system evidence, CEDEX/organization/service/PO-box endpoints, administrative/quartier/urban-plan/building/road proxies, point buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.

officialObservations.provider: La Poste - Service National de l'Adresse
officialObservations.finding: The current official allocation base contains exactly one Monaco row, 98000 MONACO. The official catalogue says Monaco is covered but postcode contours are not supplied in open data. This base does not enumerate a complete current CEDEX, organization, service or PO-box denominator.

The current geocoded CSV retains the one Monaco assignment but all Monaco coordinate fields are blank. A lines API query requesting geoshape, geopoint and commune-contour geometry returns only textual fields. No official Monaco postcode geometry is present.

Open Licence 2.0 permits reproduction, adaptation, extraction, transformation, redistribution and commercial use subject to source attribution, update date and non-misleading reuse. It clears the pinned La Poste open rows and public derived GeoJSON for reuse, but it cannot create geometry absent from those sources.

officialObservations.displayedOperatorAddress: Palais de la Scala, 98020 MONACO CEDEX
officialObservations.finding: Current operator pages and the January 2026 enterprise tariff establish a current operator publication and a 98020 MONACO CEDEX example. They provide no complete 980xx allocation table, postal Polygon/MultiPolygon or bulk address-data redistribution grant. An example is not an allocation denominator.

Current government material confirms registry-based population work and operation of official GIS, digital-twin and geographic platforms. No public licensed DPUM address/building bulk distribution, postal-membership field or postcode-area layer was found. Internal-system evidence is metadata, not public access or redistribution authority.

officialObservations.method: one convex hull around BAN address numbers significantly using each code
officialObservations.finding: The public-service derived hull release is stale, overlapping and explicitly noncanonical. Its actual 6,158-feature GeoJSON contains no 98xxx feature and therefore supplies no Monaco geometry even as a historical derived candidate.
The current metadata expressly limits coverage to metropolitan France and overseas departments/regions. It does not cover Monaco and cannot complete MC postal membership or geometry.

dataQuality.risk: Current open official assignment evidence proves ordinary 98000 but has no Monaco geometry and does not supply a complete 980xx exception denominator. The only reviewed public derived hull product has zero 98xxx features. Principality, commune, quartier, urban-plan, address, building and endpoint proxies are not postal-area authority.

browserReview.reason: No rights-cleared real MC postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Shared deterministic tests do not promote a Principality boundary, empty geometry or synthetic fixture.

blockerSummary: The current Open-Licence La Poste base proves one ordinary Monaco row, 98000, but its Monaco geometry is empty and the official catalogue states that postcode contours are not supplied. La Poste Monaco shows a current 98020 CEDEX example but no complete 980xx allocation denominator or area product. The public BAN-derived hull GeoJSON has 6,158 features and zero 98xxx records. No real rights-cleared MC postal surface or immutable artifact can be served or rendered without fabricating a Principality, commune, endpoint or address-derived proxy.
unblockConditions: Obtain an unrestricted current authoritative Monaco postcode-boundary release, or an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator and approved reproducible derivation basis for ordinary and special-routing classes.
Pin edition/effective date, all known 980xx classes and exceptions, terms, byte length and SHA-256; retain Open-Licence attribution and keep Monaco separate from France.

Validate every eligible Polygon/MultiPolygon for closure, coordinate range, topology, Monaco scope, completeness and non-areal exceptions; do not substitute the Principality/commune, quartiers, urban plans, addresses, buildings, roads, endpoints, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells or synthetic fixtures.

Publish an approved immutable artifact with no raw addresses, persons, customers, buildings, cadastral or land-right data and pass real MC normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
